secrets.name: CI_DISPATCH_TOKEN
secrets.how: Fine-grained token ci-dispatch-<date>, resource owner workbench-soft, All repositories, 1 year, Repository permissions Actions read and write.
secrets.revoke: Delete the older ci-dispatch token on https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens.
secrets.cost: Also set it as the org Dependabot and Actions secret CI_DISPATCH_TOKEN through bws run.
